notes.title: Changes in the behavior of enemy units (AI)
notes.notes:
Hi there! Over the past few days, I've been completely overhauling the AI opponents, and it seems like they're in a good state now.

Here's how it works now:

[list]
[*]Clusters of buildings are identified. Those with houses are rated better—trolls can smell dwarves!
[*]If a troll doesn't see anything interesting (trolls have a field of view and react accordingly), it heads towards the best cluster of buildings.
[*]If a building is within a troll's field of view, the troll will attack it.
[*]If a wall is within a troll's field of view, the troll will attack it.
[*]If a troll sees a building but a wall blocks its path, it will try to go around it. If there's no gap in the wall within its field of view, it will destroy the wall first.
[/list]

This should make troll behavior a bit more predictable and enjoyable. No more searching for a gap in the wall from the other end of the map!

I hope you'll enjoy playing with these changes!

notes.title: Small Update (1.0.1)
notes.notes:
Hey! I've released a minor update that includes:
- Pausing time until the construction of the first building is complete.
- Improved visibility of the status of output slots (it will be clearer whether we're currently discovering the recipe or not).
- Changes related to the reset key and reset confirmation.

notes.title: Release date announced!
notes.notes:
Good news everyone!
I've just fixed the last known bug in the game. I can now announce with a clear conscience that the game will have its premiere exactly one month from now. At that time, I will also provide information about the updates I will be working on.
